description_plain: Employee id 84584 and date 20/02/2025 late permission delete issue
comments:
1. I opening the attendance sheet, we noticed that the shift information was incorrect. When attempting to apply for a shift change, a message indicated that late permission had already been approved for that day. 
2. Despite trying to delete the late permission, the same message persisted. 
3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: 
Select * from empmaster where code='84584' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2025/02/20' AND category = 'Late'; 
Delete FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2025/02/20' AND category = 'Late'; 
4.After removing the late permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: 
Select * from attdmain where empid='' and attddate='2025/02/20' 
5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to change the shift as needed.

E. code – 1479 Name – Bharatkumar Chauhan Dates: - 03 Jan 2025 & 10 Jan 2025. Raj Nimbark Senior Officer – Human resource
comments: We are working on this.
solution:
Dear Sir,

As per the trailing email, we have reviewed the issue and found that on January 3rd and January 10th, the user missed the IN punch and directly recorded an OUT punch. As a result, the system treated the OUT punch as an IN punch since it was the first punch of the day.

Furthermore, when the user applied for a missed punch, they incorrectly submitted the IN punch in OUT punch mode, leading to this issue. As the month has already been closed, no further action can be taken at this time.

As a permanent solution, we recommend upgrading to the licensed version of MS SQL to avoid size limitations.

description_plain: Need to replace turnstile device because old device is not working.
comments:
1. The client reported that the device needs to be replaced because the old device is not working. This is a Biostamp 2C device, which has no display or keypad. I guided the IT team to connect the device to the laptop, and I shared the bootloader application with them.
2. After that, I guided them to connect the laptop to the same network, open the bootloader application, and then search for the device.
3. The device was detected, so I guided them to enter the device parameters one by one and configure the device. After that, the device parameters were saved successfully.
4. The firmware version was shown in the NetxsControl software, but the iApp software firmware needed an update. I shared the firmware with the client via email and guided them on how to update the firmware.
5. After that, I opened the software, added the new device, inserted all the device parameters, and saved the commands successfully.
6. I went to the operation menu, performed a factory reset on the device, and then set the card format for the device.
7. I went to the access group menu, added the device to all the access groups, and started the user dump process.
8. I waited for some time to complete the user dump process, and once the process was completed, the device started working fine.

name: iApp
ticket_title: Request for Detailed RCA on Unintended Spectra Service and IIS Shutdown
description_plain: Dear @Diwakar Sandip/ Spectra team, I hope this email finds you well. We are seeking clarification regarding the sudden and unanticipated shutdown of the Spectra service and IIS, which occurred due to a server restart on 25th February 2025 at 15:37. The lack of prior notice regarding this event has caused considerable disruption. Specifically, we would like to understand the following: The underlying reason behind the unexpected shutdown of both the Spectra service and IIS.If the server was indeed restarted, what caused it not to automatically restart as expected after the restart? We kindly request a detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to better understand the incident and prevent future occurrences. This event has led to significant inconvenience, and a thorough explanation will help in addressing any operational concerns. Looking forward to your prompt response and assistance in resolving this matter.
comments:
Dear Sir,

As per the trailing email, we investigated and found that the Spectra service and IIS were stopped due to the server restart on (25-02-2025 15:37). As a result, the application was not functioning.

 We have now restarted the IIS and Spectra service, and the application is working properly. Live data is also being received, so the reported issue has been resolved.

Please check and revert and Let me know if there are any other issues.
solution:
Dear Sir,

we had escalated this case to the development team, and the following is their feedback.

It's possible that when the server was restarted at the client side at that time, IIS was stopped by mistake by someone. And for service, when it was in automatic mode, it's always restarted automatically. May be due to more pending commands loaded on service, it will take time to restart. So you can choose Automatic (Delayed Start) mode to restart service automatically after some time.

description_plain: Dear @Diwakar Sandip/ Spectra team, I hope this email finds you well. We are seeking clarification regarding the sudden and unanticipated shutdown of the Spectra service and IIS, which occurred due to a server restart on 25th February 2025 at 15:37. The lack of prior notice regarding this event has caused considerable disruption. Specifically, we would like to understand the following: The underlying reason behind the unexpected shutdown of both the Spectra service and IIS.If the server was indeed restarted, what caused it not to automatically restart as expected after the restart? We kindly request a detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to better understand the incident and prevent future occurrences. This event has led to significant inconvenience, and a thorough explanation will help in addressing any operational concerns. Looking forward to your prompt response and assistance in resolving this matter.
comments:
Dear Sir,

we had escalated this case to the development team, and the following is their feedback.

It's possible that when the server was restarted at the client side at that time, IIS was stopped by mistake by someone. And for service, when it was in automatic mode, it's always restarted automatically. May be due to more pending commands loaded on service, it will take time to restart. So you can choose Automatic (Delayed Start) mode to restart service automatically after some time.
solution:

And for service, when it was in automatic mode, it's always restarted automatically. May be due to more pending commands loaded on service, it will take time to restart. So you can choose Automatic (Delayed Start) mode to restart service automatically after some time.

description_plain: In & Out Punch is not showing in front of Admin block area for last 5 days. However employees are regularly coming to duty & punching on machine. Please check & rectify the problem ASAP as employees are facing salary issue & attendance issue.

I then emailed Mr. Jignesh Prajapati from Zydus HO, requesting that he place this file on the Spectra server so I could replace the existing file. 3. After replacing the file and restarting the Spectra Worker process, the issue persisted. 4. The development team will re-examine the system to remove duplicate and unnecessary transactions from the device transactions. 5. After waiting for some time, transactions are now displaying correctly. We will monitor the system for one more day to ensure all pending transactions are cleared from the device.

name: iApp
description_plain: I Cant able to delete early application on date 01/02/2025 & 14/02/2025 Employee : 149432 - Gorantla Gowthambabu.
comments: Need to discuss with client and after delete the process.
solution:
1. I opening the attendance sheet, we noticed that the shift information was incorrect. When attempting to apply for a shift change, a message indicated that early permission had already been approved for that day. 
2. Despite trying to delete the early permission, the same message persisted. 
3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: 
Select * from empmaster where code='149432' 
SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2024/10/01' AND category = 'Early'; 
Delete FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2024/10/01' AND category = 'Early'; 
4.After removing the early permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: 
Select * from attdmain where empid='' and attddate='2024/10/01' 
5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to change the shift as needed.

name: iApp
description_plain: As discuss with you our one face machine not working properly. Kindly resolve issue Machine name : Production
comments: I connect with client and discuss about the actual issue.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that they have a Facescribe device configured for IN, while a No-Touch device is set up for OUT. The issue is that the user can punch on the Facescribe device, and it shows "Access Allowed," and the door opens. However, when the user punches on the No-Touch device, the door does not open.

We checked all the necessary configurations, and everything seemed to be in order. To gain a better understanding of the issue, we requested the user to provide a video. After receiving the video, we forwarded it to our hardware team, who provided a file that we then updated on the Face Portal.

After updating the file, the user confirmed that the system is now working as expected.

name: iApp
description_plain: Client reported that one device is not working and need urgent support due to audit.
comments:
1. I connected with the client and requested them to arrange remote access so I can check from here as well.
2. After some time, the client shared the remote access with me. I connected and opened the software, including netxsdownloading.exe and synchronizer.exe. The client claimed that a continuous beep sound was coming from one device, and data was not displaying.
3. I opened netxsdownloading, selected the controller, and found that the device was not selected.
4. I went to the controller utility page and checked the device's status, finding that more than 65,000 transactions were pending.
5. I selected the device in netxsdownloading's controller to start downloading and requested the client to kindly wait for some time to clear the pending transactions from the device.

name: iApp
description_plain: Old canteen device is not working so need to replace the device.
comments:
1. Our hardware engineer visited the location and found that the canteen device was not working, so the device needed to be replaced with a new one.
2. Afterward, I opened the database page and found that the device was showing as inactive, so I accessed the Zydus server to check the IP address.
3. The new device's IP was showing as active, so I opened the bootloader application, searched for the device, and confirmed that the device parameters were correct.I then opened the software, selected the same model device, and edited the device's MAC address.
4. I saved the device, but the device command went into a pending state. So, I opened the database menu and executed the following queries: 
   - Select * from controllermaster where ipaddr='';
   - Select * from machinedata where controllerid='' and status='P';
5. I found that more than 400 machine data entries were showing as pending. I waited for 5 minutes to clear all the pending data, and then the device parameters were successfully saved.
6. After that, I started the user dump process on the device and waited for some time for the process to complete.
7. The process is now complete, and the device is working fine.

description_plain: Need your support immediately to migrate the data base from old server to new server.
comments:
We understand your requirements for the server migration. Please take the following backup files for the server migration:

Take a full ARS database backup from the old server system.
Install the current or advanced SQL version on the new server in mixed mode.
Please refer to the mentioned requirements and let us know if any assistance is required.

solution:
We took a remote session of the user and found that the user has the iApp software installed on the server system. However, due to performance issues, they wanted to transfer the software along with the database to a new server. Upon checking, we found that the user has iApp version 4.1.87.0 on the current server.

To proceed, we instructed the user to take a full iApp database backup from the old server and install the current or advanced SQL version on the new server in mixed mode. After fulfilling these requirements, we took a remote session on the new server and performed the following steps:

Took a backup of the iApp application folder and database, then moved them to the new server.
Enabled all IIS features required for iApp on the new server.
Restored the iApp database on the new server.
Installed the iApp setup on the new server.
Installed the latest .NET Framework on the new server.
Updated the iApp version to 4.1.93.0 on the new server.
Opened the Spectra panel and configured the restored database for the iApp application.
Deleted the Spectradb file from the old server to restrict the application on the old server.
Verified that the database was reflecting the correct data, including punches up to the current date.

description_plain: Dear Team,We are facing some problems with the software. The attendance data is not getting downloaded. Request you to kindly assist in the same regards.
comments: We have called user but user is not reachable at moment.
solution:
We conducted a remote session with the user and discovered that the user was unable to download attendance data using the ARS Win Pro software. Upon investigation, we found that the 'Get Status' module in the Reader utility was not functioning correctly.

To resolve this issue, we replaced the existing Netserver.dll and TCPutility.dll files with updated versions and registered them appropriately. After implementing these changes, the user is now able to download the attendance data successfully.

ticket_title: Absent shown after 7 hrs working in Panchkula location.
description_plain: Employee Vikas (Employee Code: ZPL-22-2995) was scheduled for Shift G on February 26th, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. He punched in at 8:59 AM and punched out at 4:02 PM, resulting in 7 hours and 3 minutes of work. However, his attendance status is recorded as 'A' (Absent) instead of 'PH-AH' (Present - Authorized Holiday), which is causing discrepancies in his attendance records.
comments:
We conducted a remote session with the user and found that Employee Vikas (Employee Code: ZPL-22-2995) was scheduled for Shift G on February 26th, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. He punched in at 8:59 AM and punched out at 4:02 PM, resulting in 7 hours and 3 minutes of work. However, his attendance status was recorded as 'A' (Absent) instead of 'PH-AH' (Present - Authorized Holiday), causing discrepancies in his attendance records.

To rectify this, we reviewed the attendance policy and identified that the issue occurred because the "Compare with Shift Hours" option was selected. This setting calculates work hours based on the assigned shift, leading to discrepancies when actual work hours don't align perfectly with the shift schedule. Therefore, we changed the setting to "Compare with Flat Hours," where 8 hours worked are considered a full day present, and 4 hours are considered a half day present.

After making these changes to the attendance policy, we reprocessed the records, and the system now reflects the correct attendance status for Employee Vikas.

To rectify this, we reviewed the attendance policy and identified that the issue occurred because the "Compare with Shift Hours" option was selected. This setting calculates work hours based on the assigned shift, leading to discrepancies when actual work hours don't align perfectly with the shift schedule. name: iApp
description_plain: Iapp not working please check this urgently.
comments:
1. The client reported that the iApp is not working. When they open the iApp, it shows "continue loading" on the page.  
2. I opened the software, and it continued loading. I checked the Zydus server and monitored the CPU consumption, which appeared normal at 50-60%.  
3. I executed the following query to check the CPU processes that were taking too much time to run:  
```sql
SELECT r.cpu_time AS cpu, s.login_name,
DATEDIFF(SECOND, last_request_start_time, getdate()) AS Seconds,
s.session_id AS SessionID, blocking_session_id AS Blocking,
SUBSTRING(st.text, (statement_start_offset/2)+1, 
          ABS(((CASE statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text)
          ELSE statement_end_offset END - statement_start_offset)/2) + 1 )) AS statement_text,
OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(objectid, r.database_id) AS SchemaName
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(sql_handle) AS st
ORDER BY Seconds DESC;
```
4. I found that several processes were taking an excessive amount of time, with some showing over 1200 seconds of runtime, and they were still running.  
5. I canceled the processes from the database and restarted the IIS server. After that, the iApp started working properly.  
6. After some time, the same issue occurred, so I followed the same process, and now the iApp is working fine again.
solution:
1. The client reported that the iApp is not working. When they open the iApp, it shows "continue loading" on the page.  
2. I opened the software, and it continued loading. I checked the Zydus server and monitored the CPU consumption, which appeared normal at 50-60%.  
3. I executed the following query to check the CPU processes that were taking too much time to run:  
```sql
SELECT r.cpu_time AS cpu, s.login_name,
DATEDIFF(SECOND, last_request_start_time, getdate()) AS Seconds,
s.session_id AS SessionID, blocking_session_id AS Blocking,
SUBSTRING(st.text, (statement_start_offset/2)+1, 
          ABS(((CASE statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text)
          ELSE statement_end_offset END - statement_start_offset)/2) + 1 )) AS statement_text,
OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(objectid, r.database_id) AS SchemaName
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(sql_handle) AS st
```

description_plain: Device replaced with 12 Pharma-A Sr no BCC61A00F78D due not working New Device Sr.no BCC61A015B50
comments:
1. The client reported that the new device needs to be replaced because the old device is not working.
2. I requested them to share the MAC address of the new device, and once I received it, I updated the MAC address of the device.
3. The command was not successful, so I accessed the Zydus server and checked the device's IP, which was showing as active. I then opened Hercules.exe and performed a factory reset of the device with the following command:  
   36 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 36 00
4. The device's factory reset was completed, but it is still not showing as active. I suggested they check the server port of the device.
5. The client visited the device's location, but the server port is not showing. I need the server port to activate the device, so our engineer will visit the site tomorrow. The client confirmed that they will check it tomorrow.
solution:
1. After that, the punch was not working and showed an error. I found that the firmware was "netxscontrol," which was incorrect, so I needed to update the firmware. I sent the firmware to Mr. Nirav Patel and guided him on how to update it.
2. After the firmware update was completed, the card sensing still wasn't working. I set the card format multiple times, but it still didn't work.
3. I then took the Zydus server, performed a factory reset on the device, and started the user dump process on it.
4. After the user dump process was completed, the card sensing still wasn't working.
5. I discussed the issue with the hardware team, and we determined that the device needed soldering due to the card format issue. After that, the device started working fine.

SELECT * FROM adjustapply (nolock) WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1 AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-11-26' AND '2025-03-06' 
UPDATE adjustapply SET f7 = NULL WHERE category='Overtime' AND SendAppTo='-10' AND laststatus IN('P','U') AND f7=1 AND attddate BETWEEN '2024-11-26' AND '2025-03-06' 
3. After executing the update and allowing some time for processing, all the OT applications were successfully cleared. 
4. Now Pending OT has been cleared and OT is showing pending at respective approval.

ticket_title: Zydus Daman Plant Unit 2 Turnstile Rotating automatically
description_plain: Dear Spectra Support Team , As per today meeting with spectra team . Pl look on priority and resolve the problem of Daman site. Sr. No. Issue Remarks 1 Unit 2 The turnstile is rotating automatically without any punch and since yesterday completely bypassed . Not working from last 6 Month
comments:
1. The client reported that the turnstile devices of Unit-2 are not working; they are getting stuck and not rotating.
2. I contacted the client and found that when an employee tries to punch the device, the command is successfully sent, and the turnstile rotates. However, after rotating, the turnstile gets stuck and does not lock again, allowing any employee to pass without punching the device.
3. I opened the database menu in the software and found that all the devices were showing as active in the software.
4. After that, I opened the exceptions menu, edited the Daman rule, selected all the Unit-2 turnstiles, and enabled arm mode for all the turnstile devices. The command was successfully sent.
5. Now, the turnstile is working fine and rotating properly.

description_plain: Attendance data is not reflecting for Ankleshwer location
comments:
We received a call from the user at the Ankleswar location, claiming that they are unable to see the attendance data from March 8th to the present.

We tested with one employee and found that the punch data is reflecting in Miscellaneous and also in the Access Control Transaction view.

After performing multiple troubleshooting steps, we discovered that the StopProcess.exe file in the Spectra Services folder was causing the issue by preventing the attendance data from transferring from Access Control to Attendance.

We removed the StopProcess.exe from the Services folder and executed the following queries on the database to check the data.

We checked the AttdDetails table and found all the data that had not been transferred from Access Control to the Attendance module.

Once we removed StopProcess.exe, the data transfer started automatically. However, since the data volume is large, it will take some time to reflect in the attendance sheet.

ticket_title: Assign new IP address into Finger Access Devices
comments:
We received an email from the user stating that they want to change the device IP for the attached snapshot device. As per their request, we changed the device IP from the front end for all the mentioned devices.

After confirming the IP update, the user mentioned that their IT person would change the IP on the device and would contact us if any assistance is required from our end.

We are now waiting for confirmation from their end to verify if the IP has been changed, so we can check whether the device is online or offline.
solution: We received an email from the user stating that they want to change the device IP for the attached snapshot device. As per their request, we changed the device IP from the front end for all the mentioned devices. After confirming the IP update, the user mentioned that their IT person would change the IP on the device and would contact us if any assistance is required from our end. We are now waiting for confirmation from their end to verify if the IP has been changed, so we can check whether the device is online or offline.After confirming the IP update, the user mentioned that their IT person would change the IP on the device and would contact us if any assistance is required from our end.We received a call from their IT team requesting the MAC addresses for all the devices. We have provided them in the attached snapshot.We received a call from the user stating that they have updated the new device IP on the devices, but the device is still not showing online on iApp. To rectify this, we asked the user to ping the device IP, but the IP was not pinging. We then requested a video call from the user. After checking, we found that the local port and server port were entered incorrectly. To resolve this, we checked the iApp device management and updated the local port to 9991 and the server port to 9997 on the devices. After this, we were able to ping the device, and it responded. However, the device is still not showing online. To investigate further, we tried to access the iApp, but it is not working. Once the iApp is functioning properly, we will check and update the user on whether the reported issue has been resolved.We connected via TeamViewer and found that even after changing the device IP both in the software and on the device, it is still not coming online. We checked and also changed the local port and server port, but the device is still not online, although the device IP is pinging. We suspect that there might be a network issue causing the problem, but their network personnel have confirmed that there are no issues or blockages on the network side. For further cross-verification, we have asked the user to provide the MAC address mentioned on the back of the device, as well as in the network parameters, along with the changed IP address to help rectify the issue.We connected via Teams with the Zydus HO IT team and the Zydus Hospira IT team. We informed the Zydus HO IT team that we had changed the device IP addresses of the below-mentioned devices, both in the software and on the devices themselves. We also checked that the device IPs are pinging on the local server system, but the devices are still not showing as online. To resolve this, we asked the Zydus HO IT team to check if there were any restrictions or blockages from the server (172.24.52.126) for the following IPs: 172.29.129.5, 172.29.129.6, 172.29.129.8, and 172.29.129.9. After they whitelisted the mentioned IP range on the server, we checked again and found that all the mentioned devices are now online. For reference, please find the attached snapshot.

description_plain: Iapp software is not working.
comments:
1. When I try to open the iApp, it's not working and shows "site cannot be reached."
2. I checked the Zydus server and reviewed the 'CPU utilization,' which was normal. Then, I executed the query below to check the process consuming more CPU:
   ```sql
   SELECT r.cpu_time AS cpu, s.login_name,
   DATEDIFF(SECOND, last_request_start_time, GETDATE()) AS Seconds,
   s.session_id AS SessionID, blocking_session_id AS Blocking,
   SUBSTRING(st.text, (statement_start_offset / 2) + 1,
             ABS(((CASE statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(st.text)
             ELSE statement_end_offset
             END - statement_start_offset) / 2) + 1)) AS statement_text,
   OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(objectid, r.database_id) AS SchemaName
   FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
   INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_sessions s ON s.session_id = r.session_id
   CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(sql_handle) AS st
   ORDER BY Seconds DESC;
   ```
3. I did not find any high CPU processes, so I discussed the issue with the internal team. No one’s system login was working in Spectra for employees. I consulted with Jignesh Sir and found that the DarwinBox policy had changed, which is why our login was not working.
4. The DarwinBox team is working on it, and we have transferred this case.

description_plain: Dear Team, The following devices are currently showing as offline (indicated by a red status), despite being powered on. Please prioritize providing support to resolve this issue.
comments: I need to discuss the case with the client and understand it.
solution:
1. I connected with the client and requested them to share remote access so I could check the issue from my end.
2. After some time, the client shared the remote access. I connected to the system and found that one device was showing as active, while the other two devices were not.
3. I checked the device connectivity by pinging the IP addresses and found that one device was not responding. I advised the client to coordinate with their IT team to check the network connection for that device.
4. I then checked the second inactive device, which was pinging properly. I opened the Bootloader application and discovered that the server port was incorrect. I updated the server port, and after that, the device started showing as active.
5. I requested the client to wait for some time to allow the system to clear the pending transactions from the device.

3. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries:
   - `Select * from empmaster where code=''`
   - `Select * from attdmain where empid='' and attddate='2025-03-04'`
4. I found an attendance record, so I deleted the attendance line from the database using the following query:
   - `Delete from attdmain where empid='' and attddate='2025-03-04'`
5. Now, the attendance is displayed correctly with the actual date of joining.

description_plain: Contractor Labour punching(In and out) is not working From February 01st onwards.
comments: Please let me know a convenient time for you to connect, and I will make myself available at the mentioned time.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that at the Chikmagalur location, contact employees were unable to punch in on the FaceScribe device, and it was showing 'Stranger.'

To resolve this issue, we checked the List Management where the employee's face was registered with the same card in Employee Master. Upon further investigation, we tried to register the contract employee's face, but while saving, we encountered the following error: 'Contractor is blocked.'

To resolve this, we performed the following steps to unblock the contractor: iApp > Contractor Management > Work Flow > Block/Unblock > Select Unblock > Select Contract Number & Validity > Save.

After unblocking the contractor, we asked the employee to punch on the device, and now the employees are able to punch in on the device, as confirmed.

description_plain: Device not getting online
comments:
As per the remote session, we configure the device, and it successfully connects to the Wi-Fi. However, the device shows the wrong time, which is 2 minutes behind the current time. To resolve this, I perform a factory reset and sync the device, but the issue persists. After that, we delete the device and re-add it with a different network, and it successfully connects to the Wi-Fi with the correct time.

Next, we check the live punch, and when the user punches on the device, it shows 'No Finger Available.' To resolve this, we assign device access to the user, and upon checking, it shows 'Access Allowed' when they punch. We also verify the transaction in the attendance sheet, and it is properly reflected in the software. Now the reported issue has been resolved.

description_plain: PWP 2 device access is not working and showing user not found error on the device.
comments:

3. The device was not showing in the bootloader application, so I requested the user to go to the device location and check the device parameters.

   `36 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 36 00`

6. I guided the user to insert the device parameters, then I checked from here and replaced the device with the correct MAC address. I saved the command, and the device parameter command was successfully executed.  
7. I then factory reset the device from the software and initiated the user dump activity on it.  
8. After the dump process was completed, the device is now working fine.

   `36 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 36 00`

name: ARSWin-Net
description_plain: Attendance sheet is not opening
comments:
We took a remote session with the user and found that they are using Communication Soft along with ARS Win Net, where punch data is transferred to ARS Win Net from Communication Soft.

The issue the user is facing is that when they try to open the Attendance sheet in the ARS Win Net software, it does not open and keeps buffering continuously.

We checked the ARS Win application folder and found that log files have not been generated since March 10th. To address this, we performed update queries on the database and re-read the attendance database by starting the Download EXE.

We also replaced the Netserver.dll and the latest ARS Win EXE, but the issue persisted. Additionally, we shrank the ARS Win database and changed the file size from limited to unlimited.

For further resolution, we backed up the application folder, uninstalled the ARS Win software, and then ran a new setup to reinstall the software. Afterward, we replaced the old application folder and renamed the old EXE. We also created new path files, but the issue remained the same.

During troubleshooting, we observed that when the old EXE, which runs as an administrator, was used, the issue occurred. However, when the EXE without admin rights was opened, there was no issue with opening the Attendance sheet.

We then guided the user to use the EXE without admin rights, as the system was restricting the application from performing when running with admin rights.

4. Next, we checked the turnstile devices, and found that some of the turnstile gate entry devices were not showing as active. I checked the Zydus server and found that the turnstile devices' IPs were active on the server. Upon reviewing the device parameters, I found that some devices had the wrong server port and local port, while others had an incorrect server IP. I updated all the device parameters accordingly.

ticket_title: Card + PIN Exception is not working for employees
description_plain: Card + PIN Exception is not working for employees
comments:
We took a remote session with the user and found that they are using the Bio Scribe 3S device in Card-Only mode for all employees. For some employees, exceptions were made, and their device mode was changed to Card + PIN mode. During the configuration, the user manually registered the PIN on the device.

The issue is that employees who have created a PIN on the device are able to access the device on which they registered the PIN, but when they try to access another device connected to the same system, they are facing an issue with the wrong password. The user confirmed that they are only able to access the system on the device where they registered the PIN and cannot access the device on which they did not generate the PIN.

To rectify this, we changed the device mode from Card-Only to Card + PIN in the device management settings so that the default PIN would be generated and sent to the employees via email. However, after making this change, we observed that employees are still not receiving the PIN link, and the email is not being triggered.

Therefore, we need to seek the QC team's help to rectify this issue.
solution:
We called the user and learned that someone from our team had connected with them. After updating the latest firmware on the device, the Card+Pin module is now working as expected.
Hence, we are closing the current ticket as the reported issue has been resolved.

name: NetXsControl Ent.
description_plain: NetXsControl software reinstallation at Daman Location.
comments: We have called user but user is not reachable at moment.
solution: We took a remote session with the user and found that the user wants to install the NetXs Control software on a new server and shut down the current system. We checked the current system where the user has NetXs Control (version 5.0.0.5) along with the MDB database. To proceed, we copied the application folder from the old server and pasted it onto the new system. We ran the NetXs Control setup and replaced the old server's backup files in the new server's application folder. We started the NetXs software, and it was running as expected. However, we were informed that on the new server, the user is unable to generate reports, and it shows "no records found." We checked the downloading process and found that data was being downloaded, but it wasn't reflecting in transactions or reports. Upon further investigation, we checked the log files on the new server and discovered that the last log file was generated on March 19th. We then took remote access to the old server and found that the downloading executable was still running there, which caused the issue. We stopped the downloading executable on the old server, copied the MDB files from both the application folder and the virtual store, and pasted them into the new server's application folder. After doing this, we checked the transactions and reports, and the data started coming through correctly. However, some data is still missing due to the multiple downloading processes. We have fetched almost all of the data, but if any data is missing, the user will need to add it manually. We also confirmed by asking the user to punch data into the device, and the data is now fetching correctly, as confirmed.

description_plain: Attendance Report issue
comments: Once client is available , they will reach out to us.
solution:
Following our recent remote session, we discussed the issue you are experiencing.

Spectra Comment: Currently, your application is running in "Null Mode," which causes the application to record punches based on the in-out hierarchy. Your requirement is for the punches to be displayed according to the device mode in the attendance sheet and reports. To address this, we would need to switch the application mode from "Null Mode" to "In-Out Mode." However, this change will impact all your data recorded to date, and we do not recommend making this adjustment.

As an alternative, we suggest instructing employees to regularly punch in and out on the device to ensure accurate tracking moving forward

comments:
1. The client reported that the attendance punch for Employee ID 102043 on 03/03/2025 was not showing in the attendance sheet.  
2. I opened the Employee Master, navigated to the Miscellaneous menu, and found that the punch was recorded in the transactions but not reflecting in the attendance sheet.  
3. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries:  
   ```sql
   SELECT * FROM empmaster WHERE code='102043';  
   SELECT * FROM attddetails WHERE empid='7232' AND attddate='03/03/2025';  
   ```
4. I found that the X flag was set for that attendance punch, so I updated the process flag to 'P' and reprocessed the attendance.  
5. The punches are now showing correctly.
solution:

2. I opened the Employee Master, navigated to the Miscellaneous menu, and found that the punch was recorded in the transactions but not reflecting in the attendance sheet.  
3. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries:  
   ```sql
   SELECT * FROM empmaster WHERE code='102043';  
   SELECT * FROM attddetails WHERE empid='7232' AND attddate='03/03/2025';  
   ```
4. I found that the X flag was set for that attendance punch, so I updated the process flag to 'P' and reprocessed the attendance.  
5. The punches are now showing correctly.

description_plain: Staggered Weekly Off Application
comments: We will connect after lunch at 3 PM.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that she is able to change her week off, but other employees are unable to do so.

After checking, we found that the user who is able to change the week off has an Administrator role, which gives her the rights to make this change. The employees who are unable to change their week off have the Webportal role, where the week off change right is not granted.

With approval, we added the Shift Change rights to the Webportal role. We have checked and confirmed that the issue is resolved, as the employees are now able to change their week off.

Also Punching data is not being showing in attendance application. So I request to you please help for solved this issue.
comments:
1. Client reported that contract workers are not showing in the contract master menu and when he filter by location then only one contract person is showing on it.
2. I check fr1. The client reported that contract workers were not appearing in the contract master menu. When filtering by location, only one contract worker was visible.

3. I discussed the case with Setul Sir, and with his assistance, we removed the duplicate entry from the database. After that, all contract workers started showing correctly in the system.om here and same issue found so i took the zydus server and check in allusers table and found -1 duplicate entry to the worker that's why other contract workers are not showing.
3. I discuss this case with setul sir and with the help of setul sir we remove the duplicate entry of the contract worker in the database and after that now all contract persons are showing correctly in the system.
solution:
1. The client reported that contract workers were not appearing in the contract master menu. When filtering by location, only one contract worker was visible.  
2. I checked the issue and found the same problem. I then accessed the Zydus server and examined the `allusers` table, where I discovered a duplicate `-1` entry for a worker, which was preventing other contract workers from displaying.  
3. I discussed the case with Setul Sir, and with his assistance, we removed the duplicate entry from the database. After that, all contract workers started showing correctly in the system.

name: iApp
description_plain: Adecco Leave Balances Adjustment
comments:
We conducted a remote session with the user and identified concerns regarding the Paid Leave (PL) balances for Adecco off-roll employees. The leave balances in Spectra do not align with your internal leave balance records.

Findings:

Up to December, total leave balances for all off-roll employees were maintained.
However, prior to the year's end, the Leave Carry Forward process was not executed. This omission resulted in January 2025 opening balances defaulting to 1 day, instead of carrying forward the previous year's balances.
Consequently, by March, each employee's leave balance shows 3 days.
Recommended Actions:

Calculate Current Balances:

Deduct the leave days consumed by each employee over the past three months from their December balances.
This calculation will provide the accurate current leave balance for each employee.
Prepare CSV Files for Spectra Software:

Create two separate CSV files:
Negative Balance File: List employees with negative leave balances, specifying the amount to be adjusted.
Positive Balance File: List employees with positive leave balances, detailing the adjustment amounts.
solution: We took a remote session with the user, and as suggested, the user provided a CSV file of the PL leave balance until December 2024. We have updated the leave balance to be effective from January 1, 2025. After that, we checked the leave balance, which is now showing as expected.

Confirmed that the issue was with the SQL database storage, not the application.

description_plain: Dear All, Please help the main gate punching machine was purchased less than 15 days ago, and it is showing this error. Please take action.
comments:
1. The client reported that the attendance device at the main gate was not working and displayed a 'time corrupted' error on the screen.
2. I reviewed the video and discussed the issue with the hardware team. They suggested performing a factory reset on the device.
3. After performing the factory reset, the device stopped working, continuously emitted a beep sound, and the display was not functioning.
4. Upon further discussion with the hardware team, we identified a GSM error. I requested the client to send the device to the Spectra service centre for inspection and repair by our hardware team.
5. Since the client needed a replacement device, I guided them through entering the necessary device parameters.
6. I accessed the Zydus server, checked the device IP, and confirmed that it was pinging properly. Then, I opened the Bootloader application to update the device firmware. 
7. Next, I accessed the software, updated the MAC address of the device, and saved the command. However, the command remained pending. I restarted the device using the Bootloader, and after that, the command was successfully executed.
8. I initiated the user dump process and waited for it to complete. 
9. Once the process was completed, the device started working properly.
solution:
1. The client reported that the attendance device at the main gate was not working and displayed a 'time corrupted' error on the screen.
2. I reviewed the video and discussed the issue with the hardware team. They suggested performing a factory reset on the device.
3. After performing the factory reset, the device stopped working, continuously emitted a beep sound, and the display was not functioning.
4. Upon further discussion with the hardware team, we identified a GSM error. I requested the client to send the device to the Spectra service centre for inspection and repair by our hardware team.
5. Since the client needed a replacement device, I guided them through entering the necessary device parameters.
6. I accessed the Zydus server, checked the device IP, and confirmed that it was pinging properly. Then, I opened the Bootloader application to update the device firmware.

description_plain: We can log in to Time attendance, but devices are not connected . We can show data till 13th March 25. We have checked internet connectivity from our side . There is no issue. Attached screen shot. Pls check.
comments:
1. The client reported that all devices at Goa Agiolex are showing as inactive.
2. I connected with the Goa network team via a Teams call to check the IP ranges of 46 and 47. The network team confirmed that the ports and IPs are already enabled.
3. I requested them to go to the device locations so we could check the device parameters. Upon arrival, we examined the devices and found that the subnet mask and gateway settings were incorrect, causing the devices to appear inactive in the software.
4. We updated the device parameters, and the devices became active. Subsequently, we updated the subnet mask and gateway on all six devices.
5. After these updates, all devices are now showing as active in the database and are functioning correctly.
solution:
1. The client reported that all devices at Goa Agiolex are showing as inactive.
2. I connected with the Goa network team via a Teams call to check the IP ranges of 46 and 47. The network team confirmed that the ports and IPs are already enabled.
3. I requested them to go to the device locations so we could check the device parameters. Upon arrival, we examined the devices and found that the subnet mask and gateway settings were incorrect, causing the devices to appear inactive in the software.
4. We updated the device parameters, and the devices became active. Subsequently, we updated the subnet mask and gateway on all six devices.
5. After these updates, all devices are now showing as active in the database and are functioning correctly.

ticket_title: Turnstile LAN moraiya OUT 2 Device Configuration
description_plain: Dear Team, Turnstile OUT 2 which is not working from last 6 months. Know device repaired and connect with network but still not showing on database. Request to you please configure this device with system. [MAC Add showing on Device-049162032E14 and Device IP same as showing below] Thanks &
comments: Task is running
solution:
1. The client reported that the repaired device has been received and needs to be configured, along with performing a user dump, as punching is not working.  
2. I accessed the database menu and found that the device IP was showing as inactive.  
3. I then checked the Zydus server and found that the device IP was functioning correctly. Next, I opened the bootloader application and verified the device parameters, which were correctly configured.  
4. I accessed the software, navigated to the device settings, changed the MAC address, and saved the command. However, the command remained pending, so I checked the server database and executed the following queries:  
   ```
   SELECT * FROM controllermaster WHERE ipaddr='';
   SELECT * FROM machinedata WHERE controllerid='' AND status='P';
   ```
5. I found that more than 2,000 transactions were pending. To resolve this, I deleted the pending transactions using the following query:  
   ```
   DELETE FROM machinedata WHERE controllerid='' AND status='P';
   ```
6. After deleting the pending commands, I restarted the device, and the commands were successfully executed.  
7. I then performed a factory reset on the device using the software and initiated the user dump process, allowing time for it to complete.  
8. The process is now complete, and the device is functioning correctly.

ticket_title: FW: [EXTERNAL] Fwd: FW: Main Gate Punching Machine
description_plain: Thank you for your support. Request you to share your feedback and rate our services offered by clicking the feedback link below.
comments:
1. The client reported that the main gate attendance device is not working and an error is showing on the display.  
2. I checked from here and found a hardware issue with the device, so I requested them to send the device to the Spectra Service Centre for our team to inspect and resolve the hardware issue.  
3. The device needs to be replaced with a new one as the old one is not functioning. Once the client replaced the device, I guided them to input the network parameters into the new device.  
4. Afterward, I checked the device's IP in the server and confirmed that the IP is functioning correctly. I then opened the bootloader application and updated both the firmware and network parameters of the device.  
5. I accessed the software, edited the device details, and updated the new MAC address. When I saved the command, it showed as pending, so I performed a factory reset on the device using the Hercules application with the following command:  
   `36 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 36 00`  
6. The device was successfully factory reset, and the command was executed successfully. I then started the user dump process on the device and waited for the process to complete.  
7. Once the process was completed, I set the card format on the device.

name: iApp
description_plain: unable to move the punch
comments:
To resolve the reported issue, please follow these steps:

    First, remove the "Card Forgotten" application.

    Next, move the punch for the next day.

    Once completed, reapply the "Card Forgotten" application.

After performing these steps, the issue has been successfully resolved.
solution:
As discussed during our call, the issue arises after approving the "Card Forgotten" application punches, which are being moved.

This is happening because the B shift has a maximum work hour limit of 16:30, and the shift timing is from 15:00 to 23:30. Based on the maximum work hours, the shift extends to the next day, ending at 07:30. Upon observation, this issue typically occurs when employees are transitioning from B shift to A shift, with A shift starting at 07:00. This results in a conflict, as the first punch of the A shift is being moved to the previous day’s B shift.

To resolve this, we will need to reduce the maximum work hours for the B shift, which should help prevent these types of conflicts.

This is happening because the B shift has a maximum work hour limit of 16:30, and the shift timing is from 15:00 to 23:30. Based on the maximum work hours, the shift extends to the next day, ending at 07:30. Upon observation, this issue typically occurs when employees are transitioning from B shift to A shift, with A shift starting at 07:00. This results in a conflict, as the first punch of the A shift is being moved to the previous day’s B shift.

To resolve this, we will need to reduce the maximum work hours for the B shift, which should help prevent these types of conflicts.

name: iApp
description_plain: The newly configured main gate attendance device has been showing only 26% completion of the user data upload process since yesterday.
comments:
1. The client reported that the user dump process initiated but is operating very slowly, reaching only 25% completion since yesterday.
2. Upon accessing the database menu, I observed that the user dump process is active but remains at 25% completion. Consequently, I connected to the Zydus server and executed the following queries:
   ```sql
   SELECT * FROM controllermaster WHERE ipaddr='';
   SELECT * FROM machinedata WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE controllerid='' AND status='P';
   ```
3. Noting the sluggish performance of the user dump process, I deleted the machine data associated with the specific device from the backend and canceled the user dump command using:
   ```sql
   DELETE FROM machinedata WHERE controllerid='' AND status='P';
   ```
4. After restarting the dump process and waiting for two hours, the process continued to run slowly. I then checked the device's IP connectivity and found that the device's IP address was intermittently unresponsive to ping requests.
5. After multiple attempts, including restarting the device, the issue persisted. I captured screenshots of the IP ping status and shared them with the client, advising them to consult their IT team for further assistance.
solution:
1. Our hardware engineer, Mr. Raj, visited the location and found that the main gate attendance device was not functioning properly.​He replace the device with new one and i configure the device in the software as replacement.​
2. He replaced the device with a new one, and I configured it in the software as a replacement.​
3. After that, I set the card format of the device and started the user dump process.​
4. I waited for the user dump process to complete on the device, and now it is working fine.

ticket_title: I App Query of torrent pharma Dahej
description_plain: There Are few Query in Torrent Pharmaceutical Dahej Location, 1) Query :- After approval of Overtime of individual employees, their attendance punch data is dislocated. For Example:- (A) Name:- Mr. MAHENDRA JAMBHALE (E-122402) worked on · Date-13.02.2025 Second Shift (In time:- 14:58 & Out time:- 06:45) · Date-14.02.2025 Night Shift (In Punch:-22:49 & 06:45) · Date-15.02.2025 Second Shift (In time:- 14:44 & Out time:- 06:45) 2) Query :- After approval of late permission (IN punch in case of Bus Late), out punch also get early permission in only one application. Example:- (A) Name:- Ms. HIRAL PARMAR (E-137202) · Hiral Parmar Working every day in general shift and if she apply late permission in In time System auto accept in early permission · Also in Waiver permission same issue we face. (B) Name:- Ms. ROSHANI PATEL(E- 134788)
comments: I check and update the client
solution:
Hello Sir,

Overtime Approval and Dislocated Attendance Punch Data:
The issue occurred due to the maximum shift hours configuration. After approving overtime, the system treats forgotten application punches based on the maximum shift hours. For example, the B1 shift operates from 14:30 to 23:00 (08:30), with a maximum working time of 09:55 hours, meaning the B1 shift technically ends around 00:30. However, if an employee leaves the organization the following morning at 06:45, which exceeds the maximum shift duration, the punch-out time is recorded for the next day. To resolve this, you will need to adjust the punches according to the employee's actual working hours.

Late/Early Application and Waiver Issue:
As discussed over the call, you need to configure both the first and second halves of the shift. Currently, you have configured the entire shift in the first half timing, which is why the waiver and permission are being applied to the entire shift, rather than just the first half. This configuration issue causes the system to count an employee as present, even if they do not complete their 9 working hours.

IN Punch at 23:21:49 on the Fill in Finished Device

OUT Punch at 23:26:35 on the OUT-Device-T5 Biologics (Turnstile)

However, the user mentioned they were unable to find the transaction for this employee. Upon verification in the Access Control module, we confirmed that the transaction exists.

We also accessed the server remotely, checked the database and service Datalog files, and found the same records in both the Miscellaneous section and the Transaction View.

Please review the details from your end and let us know if we have missed anything.

Additionally, we would like to highlight that if you are referring to the attendance sheet of the employee, we observed that only the IN punch is displayed, while the Turnstile punch is missing. Upon checking the Access Control Attendance settings, we found that the Turnstile device has not been added, which is why its punch data is not reflecting in the attendance sheet.

For your reference, all relevant snapshots are attached. Please review them and let us know if any further assistance is required.

ticket_title: Device installed at main gate is not capturing the access
description_plain: The attendance access device set up at the main entrance is failing to record access. While the system is operational at the Ambernath site and not establishing communication from server end. Please look into it.
comments:
We contacted the user and found that they are experiencing issues with the device 172.20.34.94 at Ambernath New. The user is sometimes unable to punch on the device, and punch records are not visible in the transaction view.

To investigate the issue, we found that the device has been offline since March 20th.

We asked the user to ping the local server, and it responded successfully.

We then pinged the main server, and it also responded successfully.

Upon checking the bootloader on the server, we found that the Subnet Mask was incorrectly configured on the device.

The incorrect Subnet Mask (255.255.255.255) was preventing the device from showing online. We corrected it to 255.255.255.000, and now the device is online.

Regarding the issue where users are unable to punch on the device, we have initiated the User Dump process. However, due to multiple pending commands, this process will take some time.

Once the User Dump process is complete, we will update you on the next steps.

ticket_title: Biometric Device Not Functioning Properly   - Topical Unti
description_plain: Dear Spectra Team, We are facing an issue with the bio mini device at Topical Unit. The service is not running automatically. It scans the fingerprint only once, and then the bio mini is hangs, with the bio mini light remaining continuously on.
comments: We have called user but user is not reachable at moment.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that they were unable to register a fingerprint through BioMini.

Upon investigation, we confirmed that the BioMini setup and driver were already installed. We then checked the Spectra Client Service and found that it was stopped.

We started the service and asked the user to try registering the fingerprint again.

The user is now able to register the fingerprint successfully.

description_plain: Dear Spectra Team, As in recent Case Of Mr Hardik Baraiya of Adc I have Tried Several Times But his fingerprint is not being detected by the Spectra device despite multiple attempts. I have discussed this situation with him, and it appears to be a biometric issue. So he has to come inside from card only without fingerprint but turnstile one is not letting him in it is showing No User Found. Location - API Ahmedabad
comments:
1. The client reported that when an employee attempts to access the turnstile device, it displays "User Not Found," despite access already being assigned to them.​
2. Upon investigation, I found that the turnstile device is currently inactive in the software. Consequently, when attempting to assign access, the command remains pending.​
3. I have guided the client to check the turnstile device's connectivity with their IT team. Once the device is active, they should reassign access to the employee.​

name: iApp
description_plain: Hi team, We are unable to view attendance transaction data for Employee ID-10023000 from 01Nov2024 to 29Mar2025. Pl. check and confirm. Thanks & Regards, Satish Mehetre Mobile: +91 8983090481 \ Ext. No. 7021
comments:
Dear Sir,

As per trailing email, we have reviewed the details and found that the employee ID (10023000) you provided is already blocked in the system, preventing the attendance data from being displayed.

Upon further investigation, we discovered that Hitenkumar Prajapati has two employee IDs. One of them is blocked, while the other, Employee ID (10026112), is active. The attendance data will be displayed under the active Employee ID.

Please check and revert and Let me know if there are any other issues.
solution:
Dear Sir,

As per our discussion, we have checked this issue with our development team. Their feedback is that the employee ID was marked as inactive from the Darwin side on 15th November 2024.

Additionally, I discussed this with my internal team member, Nitin, and found that attendance devices were installed at the Sanand location around January 2025. That is why there is no attendance data available for the old employee ID.

Since the new employee ID (10023018) was created, the attendance data has been coming through properly.

Development team comment, previously user log was not updated properly, due to this for this employee no logs were found in user log for block process. After updating CustomService.dll file in which user log was maintain properly, we can find entries in user log for blocking process. Find attachment for your reference.

5. Select the **2025 database** in the **AlterCollation.exe**.
6. Enter the correct **2024 collation** settings.
7. Click on **Script** and then **Execute**.
8. Start the download process.

comments: 1. I opening the attendance sheet, we noticed that the shift information was incorrect. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: Select * from empmaster where code='46831' SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2025/03/21' AND category = 'Late'; Delete FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2025/03/21' AND category = 'Late'; 4.After removing the late permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: Select * from attdmain where empid='' and attddate='2025/03/21' 5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to change the shift as needed.
solution: 1. I opening the attendance sheet, we noticed that the shift information was incorrect. When attempting to apply for a shift change, a message indicated that late permission had already been approved for that day. 2. Despite trying to delete the late permission, the same message persisted. 3. To address this, we accessed the Zydus database and executed the following queries: Select * from empmaster where code='46831' SELECT * FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2025/03/21' AND category = 'Late'; Delete FROM adjustapply(nolock) WHERE userid='' AND attddate='2025/03/21' AND category = 'Late'; 4.After removing the late permission, we redirected to the attendance page. However, the same error persisted when attempting to change the shift. To resolve this, we executed the following query to set the early flag to NULL mode: Select * from attdmain where empid='' and attddate='2025/03/21' 5. With this adjustment, the employee was able to change the shift as needed.

comments:
The error occurred because the C1 shift has a maximum shift duration of 18 hours, which clashes with the GS shift start time.

The C1 shift runs from 22:00 to 06:30, and due to the maximum shift hours, it technically ends at 17:00 the next day. The GS shift, however, starts at 08:30, leading to a conflict with the C1 shift timing.

To resolve the issue you reported, you will need to reduce the maximum shift hours of the C1 shift and then apply the card forgotten application.

After checking, we confirmed that the missing data for 31st March has been successfully restored and is now visible in the attendance sheet.

ticket_title: Issue regarding SDP/Extra Working Hours report
description_plain: Dear Jigneshbhai, With reference to our discussion, I am not getting any details of CW Employees. Due to this we are unable to download report of SDP. Kindly help to resolve the issue ASAP. No CW Employee Data Showing during processing of Extra Hours Muster Report Downloading: No CW Employee Data Showing : Thanks &
comments: Task is running.
solution: 1. The client reported that contract workers were not appearing for the topical location, and only contract employees from the Ambernath location were visible in the software. 2. Upon reviewing the contract master, I found that only two contract persons were listed for the dabhasa location. 3. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries in the database: ```sql SELECT * FROM contractworkforce WHERE id='-1'; SELECT * FROM apprentice WHERE id='-1'; ``` 4. Both queries returned duplicate entries with `id='-1'` for the `contractworkforce` and `apprentice` tables. 5. I discussed the issue with Setul Sir, who advised taking backups of both tables and verifying whether the `card_id` was present for these entries. Upon checking, I found that the `card_id` was missing in both tables for these entries. 6. I proceeded to back up both tables using the following queries: ```sql SELECT * INTO Contractworkforce_170425 FROM contractworkforce; SELECT * INTO Apprentice_170425 FROM apprentice; ``` 7. After securing the backups, I deleted the duplicate entries with `id='-1'` from both tables using these queries: ```sql DELETE FROM contractworkforce WHERE id='-1'; DELETE FROM apprentice WHERE id='-1'; ``` 8. Subsequently, I reprocessed the master menu, and now all contract employees are correctly displayed. The issue has been resolved.

description_plain: New joiner contract employees access is not working and showing invalid time zone on the device when punch on the device.
comments:
1. The client reported that the access for many new joiner contract employees is not working and shows an invalid time zone on the device.  
2. I requested them to share the contract person codes so I could check from my end. After that, I searched for the contract persons in the master list and found that access had already been assigned to them.  
3. I went to the access groups, reassigned the time zone to the access group, and then reassign access to the contract employees. The command was successful.  
4. After that, the access started working fine. I guided them on the same process to assign local access through the "Assign Access" menu, and now the access is working fine.

1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 200 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID.

To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: Select * into Visitor_080425 from Visitor 4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: Select * from Location Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='22' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 5. We concluded that the employee’s details were not added to the system, which is why their data was not reflecting.

We have now added the employee details to the software, and after asking the user to punch on the device again, the punch details are now showing as expected. The reported issue has been resolved.

3. I am awaiting the remote access.

4. I installed both the 64-bit and 32-bit libraries, started the Spectra client service, and requested the client to verify the functionality.
5. Upon checking from the client's side, the fingerprint scanning process is now functioning correctly.

ticket_title: FW: FW: [EXTERNAL] Re: Req. Software installation.
description_plain: With
comments:
1. The client reported that they need to reinstall the NetXsControl software on the system because the system has changed.
2. I requested them to kindly provide me with remote access so I can check from here as well.
solution:
1. The client reported that upon opening the software, UDF Report and OCX errors are displayed. 
2. I requested the client to provide remote access so I could investigate the issue. 
3. After waiting for some time, the client shared a Microsoft Teams link. I connected through the link, opened the software, and observed the same errors. 
4. I examined the UDF report file, opened the Command Prompt, and registered the UDF file using the following command: ``` regsvr32 "UDF.dll" ``` 
5. After successfully registering the UDF report DLL, I reopened the software. The UDF error was resolved, but an OCX error persisted. 
6. I checked the folder and found only 4–5 OCX files present. Additional OCX files are required, so I proceeded to share them. 
7. I shared the necessary OCX files via OneDrive, email, and WhatsApp. However, the client's system is blocking these files, and the client is currently investigating the issue on their end.
8. Now OCX files are accessible so i took the remote access by teams link and copy all the ocx files and paste to the windows --> Syswow64 folder. 
9. After that i search the syswow64 register file and run the file with CMD and register all the ocx files. 
10. Now error has been resolved and software is open and working correctly.

1. Our hardware engineer, Mr. Raj Patel, visited the location today and updated the firmware of the device by connecting it to a laptop.  
2. After the update, it was observed that the device was not getting network connectivity at the actual location due to a connection issue. Therefore, the device was temporarily relocated to the canteen area, where it successfully connected to the network. description_plain: Facing issue in transferring finger template
comments: As discussed with the partner, they will call us when they reach the site.
solution:
During the remote session, the client was facing issues with assigning access and reported that some users' fingerprints were not working on certain devices.

We investigated the fingerprint templates and found that two different fingerprints were working at the client side for the same users.

We extracted and analyzed the fingerprint data from the SQL database and provided the relevant data to the client.

We then performed a factory reset on each device, one by one.

After the reset, we configured each device with the software-based fingerprint template.

Once all devices were set up, we dumped all user data to the controller.

We informed the client to re-enroll the fingerprints for users who were facing:

Access assignment issues

Errors showing as "finger not dumped on controller"

Failed punches on devices

After re-enrollment, the users should be able to punch successfully, and the access assignment and synchronization with the controller should work properly.

4. I advised them not to open the file during the import process. They should ensure the file is closed before initiating the import.
5. Now, the process is working fine, and the concern has been resolved.

description_plain: Dear Subham, Finger Access system installed in Exit room of aseptic area does not work properly. Due to print out problem we had given the system online for rectification. After that problem start. If the system in in ON condition nobody can access the door. After Data download it shows No Data found for this time period even though the Punch done by persons.
comments: Need to check this issue with remote access because this is netxscontrol software so i am waiting for remote access.
solution:
1. The client reported that when registering punches on the production area device, the door interlocking system is not functioning correctly.​
2. I remotely accessed the system and discovered that NetXsDownloading was not operational. I initiated the download process and cleared the pending transactions from both devices.​
3. I then adjusted the card formats on both devices and ensured the date and time settings were accurate.​
4. Accessing the gate utility menu, I updated the arm mode. However, the issue persisted. I consulted with Mr. Raj Patel from the hardware team and collaborated with the user to manually open the door via the gate utility, but the problem remained unresolved.​
5. Further investigation revealed a DOTL (Door Open Time Limit) connection issue. Through a video call with the client and assistance from the engineering team, we identified incorrect connections. We guided the client to correct these connections.​
6. After the client updated the connections, the door interlocking system began functioning properly.

description_plain: Issue in software
comments:
During the remote session, we took remote access of the client system.

The client had changed the SQL password, which caused the iApp application to stop working.

To resolve the issue, we created a new Spectra database base configuration.

After that, we updated the iApp version, but the application was still not working.

We checked for Windows admin rights and found that the client had deleted the 'Administrator' user group.

We added the missing Administrator group via the SQL backend.

However, the application still showed "Location not found".

We then assigned the appropriate location rights to the user master and added the required locations in user rights.

After these changes, the iApp application started working properly.

The issue has now been successfully resolved

name: iApp
description_plain: Device configuration requires
comments:
We took a remote session with the user and found that they had sent a BioScribe 3S device for repair. As a spare, they wanted to configure a BioScribe 2C device in the system.
To proceed, we added a new device with the same IP and network credentials, and updated the same details on the device as well.
However, even after updating all the details, the device is still not coming online.
The user will reconnect with us for further troubleshooting after lunch at 2 PM.
solution:
We asked the user to connect the device directly to the laptop using a LAN cable (one end to the device and the other to the laptop).
After the connection, we took remote access of the laptop and transferred the bootloader.
Upon opening the bootloader, we found that the MAC address displayed on the device was different from the MAC address configured in iApp.
We updated the correct MAC address in the software, and the device came online.
Next, we synced the user data to the device and added the new device to the appropriate access group.
Finally, we asked an employee to punch on the device, and the user confirmed that employees are now able to punch successfully.

description_plain: Dear Spectra Team, I am writing to report an authentication issue with the Spectra application. One of our users is experiencing the following problem: When attempting to access the application via the link, they receive an "Authentication Failed" error. The user is unable to proceed further with the application. Could you please provide your availability to help resolve this issue? Looking forward to your response. Best
comments: We have called the user, and they confirmed that they will connect with us at their convenience.
solution:
We took a remote session with the user and found that they were unable to log in to iApp due to an "Authentication Failed" error.

Upon checking the user group, we confirmed that the user was already added and login access was provided. However, we discovered that, by mistake, the employee code was entered instead of the username.

To rectify this, we accessed the database and updated the correct username. We also added the user's email ID in the Employee Master.

Afterward, we cleared the browser history and asked the user to log in again. The user is now able to log in successfully, and the application is working as expected.

comments:

4. After updating the system with these changes, I guided the client to assign the appropriate shift pattern to each employee. Following this, all shift-specific patterns are now correctly displayed and can be assigned as intended.

name: iApp
description_plain: Configuration Biometric Machine in Laptop.
comments:
1. After enabling the service installation policy, the IT team directly installed the service using their ID and password. As a result, the service was not properly installed on the system and was not visible in the Control Panel.
2. I then requested the IT team to remove the service. They removed it using the Command Prompt (CMD), and the service was no longer visible. A system restart was required, so the IT team proceeded to restart the system.
3. Once the restart was completed, I attempted to reinstall the service. However, the same "policy disabled" error appeared. The IT team then reinstalled the service from their side, but the Spectra Client service was still not properly installed.
4. I requested permission to install the service from our side. After the service was removed again, I reinstalled it myself. This time, the service appeared in the Control Panel but was still not visible in the Services menu.
