Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) is a vulnerability that allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users. Mitigating XSS involves a combination of defensive programming techniques and security best practices. Here's a breakdown of how to mitigate XSS:

 

1. Input Validation and Output Encoding

    Input Validation: Always validate input from users (whether it’s from form fields, URLs, or headers) to ensure it’s in the expected format (e.g., alphanumeric characters).
        Use white-listing (only allow known good input) rather than black-listing (blocking known bad input).
    Output Encoding: Properly encode output to prevent malicious code from being executed in the browser.
        HTML Encoding: Encode special characters like <, >, and & to prevent them from being interpreted as HTML.
        JavaScript Encoding: When inserting data into JavaScript, ensure that it is properly escaped to avoid breaking the script context.
        URL Encoding: Encode any input placed into URLs.

2. Use Content Security Policy (CSP)

    CSP: This is a browser feature that helps prevent XSS by allowing developers to specify which domains the browser can load resources from (e.g., scripts, images).
    By enforcing a strict CSP, you can reduce the risk of malicious scripts being loaded or executed on your site.
    For example, you can restrict script execution to trusted sources only, and disallow inline scripts or eval().

3. Use HTTP-Only and Secure Cookies

    HTTP-Only Cookies: By marking cookies as HttpOnly, you make them inaccessible to JavaScript, preventing attackers from stealing session cookies through XSS.
    Secure Cookies: Ensure that cookies are transmitted over HTTPS to prevent interception by attackers.

4. Avoid Inline JavaScript and Event Handlers

    Avoid embedding JavaScript directly in HTML attributes like onclick, onmouseover, etc., because they can be easily exploited by attackers.
    Instead, use event listeners and external scripts.

5. Sanitize User Input

    Use libraries and frameworks designed to sanitize user input to ensure no harmful scripts are embedded.
    Examples:
        OWASP Java HTML Sanitizer (Java)
        DOMPurify (JavaScript)
        jsoup (Java)
    These libraries ensure that any input being inserted into HTML is sanitized and that potentially dangerous elements (like script tags) are removed.

6. Use Frameworks that Automatically Escape Output

    Many modern web frameworks (e.g., Django, Ruby on Rails, React) automatically escape user input when rendering data into HTML, minimizing the chances of an XSS attack.
    Use the built-in escaping mechanisms rather than manually handling user input.

7. Regularly Update and Patch Dependencies

    Keep all libraries, frameworks, and software up to date with the latest security patches.
    Attackers often target known vulnerabilities in outdated libraries, so maintaining up-to-date systems can mitigate many XSS risks.

8. Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Tokens

    Even though CSRF is a separate issue from XSS, implementing CSRF protection tokens is important in preventing malicious requests in combination with XSS.
    These tokens ensure that requests made on behalf of a user are legitimate.

9. Use Subresource Integrity (SRI) for External Scripts

    If your application uses external scripts, use Subresource Integrity (SRI) to ensure that the scripts haven’t been tampered with.
    SRI allows the browser to check if the fetched resource matches a specified hash, thus preventing malicious modifications.

10. Educate Developers and Conduct Security Reviews

    Provide ongoing security training to your development team about secure coding practices and common vulnerabilities like XSS.
    Conduct regular code reviews and security assessments to identify potential vulnerabilities.

name: iApp
description_plain: Dear spectra teamI am writing to report an issue with my attendance record. After clocking in and out for both punches, the system is still showing emp as absent, even though he worked for 11 hours.Could you please look into this and resolve itWarm Best
comments:
Problem Statement:
Punches are being recorded on the next day, even though the "Out Punch" falls within the defined maximum shift hours.

iApp Version: 91

We have created a new shift pattern and assigned it to the concerned employee. However, no changes are reflected in the output despite multiple attempts.

Observations:

    After assigning the new shift and reprocessing the records, no updates appear in the attendance sheet.

    Manually changing the shift in the attendance sheet also has no effect.

Example Case:

    On 15-April, the employee was assigned a Day Shift (08:00 – 20:00).

    Punches recorded: 08:08, 08:17, and 20:23.

    The maximum shift hours are configured as 16 hours.

    All punches are within the shift window, yet the 20:23 punch is incorrectly recorded under 16-April.

    We attempted reprocessing and adjusted the maximum shift hours to 12, 15, and 18 hours, but the issue persisted.

    Manually shifting the 20:23 punch to 15-April was successful.

    A similar issue occurred on 16-April, where a 20:05 punch was registered under 17-April, even though it falls within the same shift configuration.

Additional Info:
The Night Shift timing is from 20:00 to 08:00, with maximum shift hours also set to 16 hours.
solution:
The punches were not received in the correct sequence. For example, on 14-Apr-2025, punches were received and processed before those from the previous day. As a result, the system was unable to process the punches correctly under the auto-shift logic, which relies on sequential punch data—particularly from the previous day.

If punches are delayed in download, please ensure that your network connection is stable and properly configured.

To maintain the correct punch sequence and avoid such delays, it is essential that the network connectivity between the FaceScribe device and the iApp server is consistently active and reliable.

No issue was found in the system for the reported case.

ticket_title: Issue of missing attendance and turnstile data
description_plain: Dear sir, Since 13th April, the attendance punch data in security-1 device and turnstile data for all employees and contract workers are not reflecting in the system as a result , their attendance is being marked as absent. Since the attendance closing period is currently in progress, kindly request you to resolve this issue at the earliest and provide the necessary support to avoid discrepancies. Thanks & Regards Gajendra Singh Security I/C Liva Mob:9983029019 Tel. 02668-671426 Disclaimer: The information contained in this electronic message or in any trailing messages herein or in any attachments to this message is confidential, legally privileged and non-public information, intended to be conveyed only to the designated recipient(s). Before opening any attachment(s) to this electronic message, please check them for viruses and defects. Neither sender nor his/her organization accepts any liability for damage caused by any virus transmitted by this electronic message.’ If the disclaimer can't be applied, take no action.
comments:
1. The client reported that the turnstile devices are showing as inactive. According to the IT team's observations, the device IPs are active in the local network.  
2. I first accessed the database menu in the software and found that all the turnstile devices, ranging from IPs 11 to 16, were marked as inactive.  
3. I then accessed the Zydus server and checked each device IP one by one, confirming that all devices were successfully pinged from the server.  
4. Following this, I requested the client to power off the devices. After powering off, the device IPs showed a "request timeout," confirming that no IT conflict issue was present.  
5. I opened the Hercules application and checked the device IPs one by one with their respective ports. I found that all device IPs showed a TCP timeout error, indicating that the connection was not established on the server.  
6. I took screenshots of the issue and emailed the IT team, requesting them to check the ports and connection. The team will coordinate with the network team and provide us with an update.
solution: 1. The client reported that none of the devices have been showing in the network since April 13th, and as a result, data is not being displayed. 2. I opened the database page in the software and found that only 14 devices were active at that time. 3. I checked the Zydus server, verified the device IPs, and found that the ping was not working. I then contacted the IT team, who investigated from their side, and as a result, 25 devices became active. 4. However, the turnstile devices were still inactive. After further discussion with the network and IT teams, we identified that the issue was related to IP and port configurations on the Zydus side. 5. The IT team requested a change in the device IP range, so we updated the device IPs in the software one by one. 6. Now, all devices are active, and the pending transactions have been cleared.

description_plain:
Dear Team.

 

 

1. Overtime (OT) Calculation

a. On Normal Working Days:

    If an employee stays at least 2 hours after their scheduled shift end, they are eligible for Overtime.
    Overtime will be calculated in 30-minute intervals beyond the 2-hour threshold.

b. On Holidays or Weekly Offs:

    If an employee works for at least 4 hours, they are eligible for Overtime.
    Overtime will be calculated in 30-minute intervals beyond the 4-hour threshold.

2. Compensatory Off (C-Off) Eligibility

    If an employee works for 4 to 6 hours on a Holiday or Weekly Off, they are eligible for 0.5 Day C-Off.
    If an employee works for more than 6 hours, they are eligible for 1 Full Day C-Off.

 

Regards

Jitendra

ticket_title: Frequent auto bypass issue in unit 1 change room device
description_plain:
This is bring to your notice that we are facing an issue in unit 1, where both the male and female change room biometric device are getting auto bypassed frequently .

 

This issue is recurring and is impacting our access control system .
comments:
We took a remote session with the user and learned that they are experiencing issues with some doors, where Bio Scribe 3S devices are configured with IN/OUT readers. Currently, if anyone touches the handstamp (sensor) for 15 seconds, the emergency command is triggered on DITL and the door becomes free. However, if the sensor is touched for 30 seconds, the door remains in the same state as before.

We discussed this issue with our hardware team and learned that the resolution involves installing a software called Door Interlocking Utility on a laptop. Then, we need to connect the Door Interlocking Panel to the laptop via a USB Type B cable.

We have suggested this solution to the user, and the software has been sent via email. Once the setup is ready, the user will connect with us for further assistance.

comments:

4. I examined the UDF report file, opened the Command Prompt, and registered the UDF file using the following command:
   ```
   regsvr32 "UDF.dll"
   ```
5. After successfully registering the UDF report DLL, I reopened the software. The UDF error was resolved, but an OCX error persisted.
6. I checked the folder and found only 4–5 OCX files present. Additional OCX files are required, so I proceeded to share them.
7. I shared the necessary OCX files via OneDrive, email, and WhatsApp. However, the client's system is blocking these files, and the client is currently investigating the issue on their end.
solution:
1. Now OCX files are accessible so i took the remote access by teams link and copy all the ocx files and paste to the windows --> Syswow64 folder.
2. After that i search the syswow64 register file and run the file with CMD and register all the ocx files.
3. Now error has been resolved and software is open and working correctly.

description_plain: Hello Spectra Team, We would like your support on the below queries. Wrt the trailing mail we tried to change the reporting Manager, however we are unable to make the change. Please support.The timer for entry exit controller has to be adjusted correctly. Thanks & Regards Sonali Naik Assistant Manager – Human Resources --------------------------------------- Colorcon Asia Private Limited, Plot No. M-14 to M-18, Verna, Goa – 403722, India. Tel : +91 832 6727375 From: Anurag Patra <anurag.patra@colorcon.com> Sent: Monday, April 21, 2025 2:58 PM To: Sonali Naik <SrNaik@colorcon.com> Cc: Piraj Singh <PSingh@colorcon.com>; Gaurav Kerkar <GKerkar@colorcon.com> Subject: Over time approval routing issue. Hi, I am facing issue while applying OT on spectra. My all OT approval is going to Hr/Admin instead of my reporting manager. Attached pic for your reference. Regards Anurag Patra ---------------------------------------------- Visit us at http://www.colorcon.com This e-mail may contain information that is confidential or privileged. If you are not the intended recipient, do not use, print or distribute this e-mail or any attachments. Please notify the sender and delete the e-mail and any attachments. Thank you.
comments: We called the user, and they confirmed that they will connect with us tomorrow at 3 PM.
solution:
As connected remotely we have discussed and resolved below points,

T028513 : The timer for entry exit controller has to be adjusted correctly.

Spectra Comments :

Please refer below steps to set Date & Time.

iApp > Access Control > Device Operation > Database > Select Device > Sync > Date & Time

T028518 : Leave requests are being forwarded directly to HR instead of the reporting manager.
Spectra Comments : We found that one of the employees was applying for leave, but the leave request was being forwarded directly to HR instead of the reporting manager.

To rectify this, we checked the Sanction Application Rule, where the Gender module is selected as a condition. Upon verifying the employee master, we found that the Gender field was not filled for that particular employee, which caused the issue.

We updated the Gender in the employee master, and the user has confirmed that the workflow is now functioning as expected.

T028512 : Holiday not showing in attendance sheet
Spectra Comments : We found that although all the required holidays were added in the master, they were not reflecting in the attendance sheet.

To resolve this, we checked the configuration and found that the added holidays were not mapped to the leave policy, which is why they were not visible.

We then mapped all the holidays to the respective policies for all locations, and the holidays are now displaying as expected.

description_plain: Dear Team, Plz refer trailing mail, employee facing issue that his punching not reflecting in system. Plz note that employee working location is API plant & his attendance maintain under Zydus Biologics payroll. 101117- Kalpesh Patel
comments: The email was not received, so I will check and discuss it with the client.
solution: 1. The client reported that the in punch for employee ID 101117 is not showing for the turnstile on the date of 22 April 2025. 2. I opened the employee master, edited the employee details, and went to the miscellaneous menu, where I found only out punches recorded for that day. 3. I checked the database menu in the software, and all devices were active with no pending transactions. 4. I accessed the Zydus server and copied all the data log files from the services for the 22 of April. 5. I extracted all the data log files using the log extractor tool and filtered the data by the employee's card ID. 6. I found the in punch and recovered it by creating a Recover3S folder and restarting the Spectra Worker service. 7. After waiting for some time, now punch is showing correctly so i share the details to the client and concern has been resolved now.

comments: 1. The client reported that employee ID 112035 has already been assigned card-only access and fingerprint authentication is disabled. However, when the employee attempts to punch on the global devices, the message "finger required" still appears. 2. I checked from my end and found that fingerprint access was still required on the global access devices. I went to the "Assign Access" menu and confirmed that "Disable Finger Authentication" was already enabled for that employee. 3. I selected all the local and global devices for that employee and saved the exception. The issue is now resolved and everything is working fine.

ticket_title: FW: Regarding Out Punch not captured in Trunstiles dated on 11/04/25 of Devidas Rathod
description_plain: Dear Team, Pls find trail mail Turnstile record not found in I-App pls check and resolve this issue. Thanks &
comments:
1. The client reported that the **out punch** is not showing on **12th April** for **Employee ID 140811**.  
2. I opened the **Employee Master**, edited the employee, went to the **Miscellaneous** menu, checked the **Transactions**, and found only two transactions for that day—both were **in punches** for the **night shift**.  
3. After that, I checked the **Attendance Sheet** and found that a **manual punch** had been added for the **out punch** on that day.  
4. I then went to the **Database** menu, checked the **Devices**, and found that the **GN 7 device** was already showing as **active** in the software.  
5. I accessed the **Zydus server**, went to the **Data Log** folder, copied all the **log files** for **11th and 12th April**, and created a folder for them.  
6. After that, I opened the **Log Extractor.exe**, imported the files, and searched for the data using the employee's **card ID**.  
7. I did not find any **missing punches** for either day; all punches are correctly showing in the software. I then shared the **screenshot** with the client and confirmed that there were no missing punches in the log file either.
solution:
1. The client reported that the **out punch** is not showing on **12th April** for **Employee ID 140811**.  
2. I opened the **Employee Master**, edited the employee, went to the **Miscellaneous** menu, checked the **Transactions**, and found only two transactions for that day—both were **in punches** for the **night shift**.  
3. After that, I checked the **Attendance Sheet** and found that a **manual punch** had been added for the **out punch** on that day.  
4. I then went to the **Database** menu, checked the **Devices**, and found that the **GN 7 device** was already showing as **active** in the software.  
5. I accessed the **Zydus server**, went to the **Data Log** folder, copied all the **log files** for **11th and 12th April**, and created a folder for them.  
6. After that, I opened the **Log Extractor.exe**, imported the files, and searched for the data using the employee's **card ID**.  
7. I did not find any **missing punches** for either day; all punches are correctly showing in the software. I then shared the **screenshot** with the client and confirmed that there were no missing punches in the log file either.

ticket_title: Immediate Attention Required | VMS DUPLICATE PASS SISSUE
description_plain: This is to inform you that the issue outlined in the trailing mail is still not resolved .The duplicate passes created are still appearing in the active list.
comments: 1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 100 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID. 2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from april. 1, 2024, to 23th april, 2025, and found more than 100 duplicate entries for all Zydus technology location. 3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: Select * into Visitor_23042025 from Visitor 4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: Select * from Location Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='52' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: Delete from Visitor where id='819543' 6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.
solution: 1. The client reported that duplicate entries are generated in the VMS front desk menu. For instance, if we register 1 visitor, then 100 duplicate entries are automatically generated for the same visitor with a "-10000000" visit ID. 2. I opened the front desk menu and filtered the date from april. 1, 2024, to 23th april, 2025, and found more than 100 duplicate entries for all Zydus technology location. 3. To resolve this issue, I took the Zydus server database and first backed up all visitor data with the following query: Select * into Visitor_23042025 from Visitor 4. After taking the backup, I executed the following query to identify "-1" entries with different location IDs: Select * from Location Select * from Visitor(Nolock) where locationid='52' and Visitid='0000000000-1' 5. I found numerous duplicate entries location-wise and proceeded to delete them one by one using the following query: Delete from Visitor where id='819543' 6. After removing all duplicate entries from the system, no additional duplicate entries are showing in the front desk menu.

comments:
1. The client reported that the employee ID 107401's punch for the 21st of April is not showing.
2. I opened the employee master, edited the employee details, went to the miscellaneous menu, and checked the transactions. I found only the in-punch from that day.
3. I accessed the database menu in the software and found that all the devices were showing as active, so I connected to the Zydus server to check the punch data in the datalog file.
4. I went to the services and selected the datalog file for the 21st of April, then moved it to a new folder.
5. I extracted the folder using the log extractor exe and filtered the data by employee card ID, where I found the punch in the data.

solution:
1. The client reported that the employee ID 107401's punch for the 21st of April is not showing.
2. I opened the employee master, edited the employee details, went to the miscellaneous menu, and checked the transactions. I found only the in-punch from that day.
3. I accessed the database menu in the software and found that all the devices were showing as active, so I connected to the Zydus server to check the punch data in the datalog file.
4. I went to the services and selected the datalog file for the 21st of April, then moved it to a new folder.
5. I extracted the folder using the log extractor exe and filtered the data by employee card ID, where I found the punch in the data.
6. I created a new folder named "Recover3S," placed the file in it, and restarted the Spectra worker service. I then waited for some time for the file to recover.
7. After the file recovery was completed, the punch data was correctly displayed in the software.

comments:
1. The client reported that when they tried to check the **controller status** in the **Controller Utility**, an error appeared stating **“Class not registered.”** I requested them to share remote access so I could check the issue from my end.  
2. After some time, the client shared a **Microsoft Teams link**, which I joined. I checked the controller status and confirmed the same error. Additionally, **NetXSDownloading** was not working and was also showing an error.  
3. I checked the software's installation location and found it was on the **D: drive**. Since the system had been recently **formatted**, the software folder and pages were not configured correctly on the **C: drive**.  
4. I navigated to the **backup folder**, located the **NetXSControl setup**, and reinstalled it on the system.  
5. After installation, I copied all the necessary pages and pasted them into the **C:\Program Files (x86)** folder, then launched the software.  
6. The **controller status error** was resolved, so I initiated **NetXSDownloading**, and the downloading process started successfully.

description_plain:
Kindly find the attached screen print 
Name sandeep saini
Emp.code 147290
On dated 14/04/25 ,I came on duty in first shift and punched in both the turnstile (approx 07:05) and oncology entrance area punch section but  both the punch is not showing  while I have worked in GMP area,  Hence need your support for compliance in GMP area.
comments:
1. The client reported that the **morning in-punch** for **Employee ID 147290** was not showing in the **attendance data** for **14th April**.  
2. I opened the **Employee Master**, edited the employee details, navigated to the **Miscellaneous** menu in the software, and found that only the **out-punch** was recorded for that day.  
3. I checked the **Attendance Sheet**, which was showing the employee as **Absent** on that day. I then went to the **Database** menu and verified that all **devices were active**, with **no pending transactions** on the device.  
4. I accessed the **Zydus server**, navigated to the **Services** section, and copied all **data log files** for **14th April**.  
5. I extracted the log files using the **Log Extractor.exe**, filtered the data using the employee’s **card ID**, and found **two in-punch transactions** for that employee. I then copied the data log files and created a **Recovery folder** in the Services directory.  
6. I pasted both files into the **Recovery folder**, restarted the **Spectra Worker Service**, and waited for about **one hour** for the data to sync with the software.  
7. The **attendance data** is now displaying correctly in both the **software** and the **Attendance Sheet**.

name: iApp
description_plain:
As discussed , Please review the Spectra Data,
Because today I came by bus and my bus started at 08:10 from Bopal Cross Road however punch is showing at 08:13
comments:
1. As checked from our end, this appears to be a case of cross-punching from a production device at the GRPPL-ACME location.
2. The device is currently operating in “Free Scan” mode, which is why it is functioning in finger-only mode.
3. When a device is set to “Only Finger” mode, the system attempts to match the biometric input against all fingerprints stored in the device database and grants access based on the closest match, according to the configured security level.
4. In this case, when the employee performs a punch, the transaction is being stored under another employee’s account, as the system identifies a closer match with someone else’s fingerprint — resulting in cross-punching.
5. Below are the recommended solutions to resolve this issue:
A => We can Disable the Free Scan mode and configure the device to operate in Card + Finger mode only.
B => Re-register the fingerprints of the employees who are experiencing cross-punching issues.
6. It's a common myth that all biometric fingerprints are 100% unique. To ensure maximum security and accuracy, it is an industry best practice to use the Card + Finger mode.
solution:
1. Right now, we have disabled the free scan mode on attendance devices to prevent this instance from recurring in the future at Zydus locations.
2. The following solutions can help avoid this instance in the future:
A. Remove unnecessary global access from devices that are not relevant to employees.
B. Re-register the fingerprints of employees with a quality score of 90% or higher who are experiencing cross-punching instance.
C. Disable the free scan mode on all devices related to attendance management, access control, and canteen management.
D. Increase the sensitivity and security level on the devices.
E. To ensure 100% security and accuracy, it is an industry standard to use the "card + finger" mode.

name: iApp
description_plain: VTC location SL-SL not club and showing error.
comments:
1. The client reported that when employee ID 131311 tries to apply for SL leave for two days, it shows "SL-SL not clubbed."  
2. I opened the attendance sheet and tried to apply the leave from my end, and the same error appeared for the VTC location.  
3. I then checked the employee’s leave policy and reviewed the leave group assigned. I found that the SL clubbing rule was already defined in the policy, which is why the error occurred.  
4. As per the client’s requirement, I edited the leave group and removed the SL-SL clubbing rule from the policy, then saved the changes.  
5. After that, I applied the leave again, and no error appeared. The leave was applied successfully.

1. The client reported that the out punch for employee ID 151907 was not showing for the date of 9th April, even though the employee had punched out on the device.  
2. I opened the Employee Master, edited the employee details, navigated to the **Miscellaneous** menu, and checked the punches for 9th April. I found that only the in punch was recorded, and the out punch was missing.  
3. I went to the **Database** menu in the software and verified that all devices were showing as active.  
4. Then, I accessed the server, navigated to the services, and copied all the data log files for 9th April.  
5. I created a new folder, placed all the data log files into it, extracted them using the **Log Extractor** executable, and filtered the data using the employee’s card ID.  
6. Upon searching the logs, I found the out punch entry. I copied the relevant data log file and created a **Recover** folder under Services.

8. After waiting for the recovery process to complete, the out punch began showing correctly in the system.
solution:
1. The client reported that the out punch for employee ID 151907 was not showing for the date of 9th April, even though the employee had punched out on the device.  
2. I opened the Employee Master, edited the employee details, navigated to the **Miscellaneous** menu, and checked the punches for 9th April. I found that only the in punch was recorded, and the out punch was missing.  
3. I went to the **Database** menu in the software and verified that all devices were showing as active.  
4. Then, I accessed the server, navigated to the services, and copied all the data log files for 9th April.  
5. I created a new folder, placed all the data log files into it, extracted them using the **Log Extractor** executable, and filtered the data using the employee’s card ID.  
6. Upon searching the logs, I found the out punch entry. I copied the relevant data log file and created a **Recover** folder under Services.  
7. I placed the log file into the **Recover** folder and restarted the **Spectra Worker Service**.  
8. After waiting for the recovery process to complete, the out punch began showing correctly in the system.

comments:
1. The client reported that the in punch for employee ID 63935 is not showing for the turnstile on the date of 1st April 2025.  
2. I opened the employee master, edited the employee details, and went to the miscellaneous menu, where I found only out punches recorded for that day.  
3. I checked the database menu in the software, and all devices were active with no pending transactions.  
4. I accessed the Zydus server and copied all the data log files from the services for the 1st of April.  
5. I extracted all the data log files using the log extractor tool and filtered the data by the employee's card ID.  
6. I found the in punch and recovered it by creating a Recover3S folder and restarting the Spectra Worker service.  
7. After waiting for some time, the punch still wasn't showing in the software, so I checked the employee's card ID and discovered that the employee's card ID was lost on the 1st of April. The in punches were stored under the old (lost) card ID, while the out punches were recorded under the new card ID.  
8. Since the old card ID was lost, the transactions were not captured in the software, which is why the in punch is not showing.

5. I extracted all the data log files using the log extractor tool and filtered the data by the employee's card ID.

comments:
1. The client reported that when trying to apply a card forgotten application for employee ID 150923 for the date of 15th April, an error was displayed: "Invalid next day punch."  
2. I opened the employee's attendance sheet and found that the maximum shift hours were exceeded across the shifts on 14th and 15th April, which caused the error.  
3. I accessed the **Shift Master**, edited the shift for the previous day (14th April), and saw that the **Maximum Shift Hours** was set to 16:00 hours.  
4. I updated the **Maximum Shift Hours** to 15:00 hours and saved the changes. After that, I reapplied the card forgotten application, and it was successfully submitted.

4. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query:  
   `Select * from trans(Nolock) where status='P'`

6. After that, I restarted the Spectra Worker service and waited for some time to allow all the pending transactions to clear.  
7. Once the pending transactions were cleared, all the attendance data began showing correctly in the software.

description_plain: Employee id 137079(Mayank Satpal) auto permission not applied for the date of 17/04/2025.
comments:
1. The client reported that when they ran the month closure tardiness policy, the late permission was not auto-applied for employee ID 137079 on the 17th of April.  
2. I opened the attendance sheet for the employee and found that the employee was late by 01:18 and was marked as half-day absent, with the auto late permission not applied for that day.  
3. I went to the month closure process, selected that employee, and ran the tardiness policy. After waiting for some time, I checked the attendance sheet and reprocessed the records for that day, but the issue persisted.  
4. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following queries on the database:  
   `SELECT * FROM EmpMaster WHERE Code='137079'`  
   `SELECT * FROM AttdMain WHERE empid='76609' AND attddate IN ('2025-04-16','2025-04-17')`  
5. I found that the late permission and late hours were incorrect in the database, so I updated the late permission flag to "4" and set the late hours to 07:12.  
6. After making the update, the late permission was displayed, but it was marked in red. To resolve this, I inserted the late permission application to change the flag to green by executing the following query:  
   ```sql  
   INSERT INTO dbo.adjustapply (companyid, locationid, category, userid, dt1, dt2, dt3, dt4, dt5, dt6, dt7, dt8, dt9, dt10, Reason, shiftid, f1, f2, f3, f4, f5, f6, f7, f8, f9, f10, f11, createdby, attddate, laststatus, reasongroupid, remark, SendAppTo, appdt, grantby, grantdt, Appliedfrom, i1, i2, i3, i4, i5, AppliedRuleid, chkIndex, leaveid, SancRequired, SancDone, TPid, RejectReason, Rejectdt, AlternateManagers, AltAppTo, SystemAction, GeneratedBy, SpecificBy, ForwardingType, OrigId)

   ```  
7. After executing the query, I reprocessed the attendance records, and the late permission was applied successfully. The employee was marked as present for the full day.

The software was working fine till last Saturday. Disk space has been checked and there is sufficient free space. Basic troubleshooting was done from our side but the SQL Server service is still not starting. Request: We request your support to investigate and resolve this issue as soon as possible. description_plain: Attendance data is not showing for yesterday out punch and today for all over zydus locations.
comments:
1. The client reported that attendance data from yesterday evening to this morning was not showing for all Zydus locations.  
2. I opened the attendance sheet and checked the data for multiple employees; punches for yesterday were showing, but today's punches were missing.  
3. I checked the device connectivity and found that all devices were active, with no pending transactions.  
4. I accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query:  
   ```sql
   SELECT * FROM Trans (NOLOCK) WHERE status = 'P' AND PunchDetail BETWEEN '2025-04-28 00:00' AND '2025-04-29 23:59' ORDER BY id ASC;
   ```  
5. I also checked transactions for a specific employee ID and found that transactions were pending; the process to clear all pending data was running.  
6. I informed the client to wait for some time while the pending transactions were cleared from the server.  
7. After waiting for one hour, I checked with the client again and confirmed that all data was now displaying correctly in the software.

description_plain: employee id 153822 disable finger authentication required for all over zydus locations.
comments: 1. The client reported that employee ID 153822 has already been assigned card-only access and fingerprint authentication is disabled. However, when the employee attempts to punch on the global devices, the message "finger required" still appears. 2. I checked from my end and found that fingerprint access was still required on the global access devices. I went to the "Assign Access" menu and confirmed that "Disable Finger Authentication" was already enabled for that employee. 3. I then went to the "Workflow" menu, selected "Exceptions," and created a new exception to change the authentication mode for that employee. 4. I selected all the local and global devices for that employee and saved the exception. The issue is now resolved and everything is working fine.

I checked the device connectivity and found that all devices were active, with no pending transactions. 4. I also checked transactions for a specific employee ID and found that transactions were pending; the process to clear all pending data was running. 6. I informed the client to wait for some time we will connected with product development team and found more then 70000 plus transactions are pending and while the pending transactions were cleared from the server. 7. After waiting for 4 hours, I checked with the client again and confirmed that all data was now displaying correctly in the software.

ticket_title: Punch  Data Dowanloading Issue PTC Location
description_plain: Dear Spectra Team, Greetings. Please note that in ZLL PTC Location, As of now dtd 26/4/25 -Out and 30/4/25 In Punches not showing in system. Please check and do the needful accordingly.
comments:
1. The client reported that attendance data was not showing for many employees at the PTC Moraiya location.
2. Based on previous cases, a similar issue occurred where attendance data was missing for two days across multiple Zydus locations.
3. I checked this case with the product development team, and the issue was resolved by the developers. During the resolution process, over 70,000 pending transactions were identified and cleared within 4 hours.
4. After that, all attendance data became visible. I informed the client and requested them to check and confirm the same.
solution:
1. After the pending transaction download process was completed, the attendance data for 26th April was still not appearing for many employees. The client shared a list of affected employees with me.
2. I opened the "Miscellaneous" section in the Employee Master and checked each employee individually. I found that for some employees, the "IN" punch was missing, and for others, the "OUT" punch was not recorded.
3. I navigated to the Database menu and confirmed that the device was active, with no pending data shown.
4. I accessed the Zydus server, opened the service logs, copied all the data log files for the specified date, and extracted them using the log extractor tool.
5. I filtered the data using the card ID of one employee and found a missing punch record. I then checked the data for all other listed employees using their card IDs and confirmed that their punch records were also missing from the system but were present in the data log files.
6. I copied each relevant data log file, created a "Recover" folder in the service directory, and restarted the Spectra Worker process to allow the system to re-read the data logs.
7. After some time, the file reading process was completed, but the data still did not appear. I waited one day for the recovery process to finish.
8. The next day, all the attendance data appeared correctly in the attendance sheet. I shared the updated screenshot with the client for confirmation.

sql
Copy
Edit

No. 8A, Moraiya, ; City, Ahmedabad ; State, Gujarat ; Country, India ; Pincode, 382213 From: Nikhil K Khatri <Nikhil.K.Khatri@Zyduslife.com> Sent: Saturday, May 3, 2025 9:17 AM To: Deepak Dodiya <Deepak.Dodiya@Zyduslife.com>; support@spectra-vision.com <support@spectra-vision.com>; 'Shubham Dasadiya' <shubham@spectra-vision.com> Cc: Jainam P. Mehta <JainamP.Mehta@zyduslife.com>; Mehul N Vaghela <Mehul.N.Vaghela@zyduslife.com>; Sumit K Tiwari <Sumit.K.Tiwari@ZydusLife.com>; Jignesh M. Prajapati <Jignesh.Prajapati@ZydusLife.com> Subject: RE: Unable to reject the Unauthorized leave applied without informing me by Mr. Mayur Patel. Emp. 120141 @support@spectra-vision.com: Please look into as per the trail mail and attached mails for your better clarification.
comments:
1. The client reported that when attempting to reject an employee's leave application, an error appears stating: 'String or binary data would be truncated. The statement has been terminated.
2. I opened the employee's sanction application page and found that all recent leave applications are in a pending state.
3. I requested the client to share the employee's login credentials so I can check the issue from my end as well.
solution:
1. Client's Request: The client provided login credentials to access the system. I navigated to the sanction application page to reject the application. I entered the remark as per the client's specifications; however, the same error persisted.
2. Investigation : Upon reviewing the remark, I found it to be 5–7 lines long. I shortened the remark text and proceeded to reject the application successfully.
3. Explanation to Client: I informed the client that, according to the system's logic, long remarks are not accepted, which is why the error occurred.
4. Recommendation: I advised the client to limit the remark text to a shorter length before rejecting the leave application to avoid similar issues in the future.

description_plain: Dear Spectra Team Kindly do need full. Regards Komal Patel From: Komal MP Sent: 06 May 2025 14:34 To: Shubham Dasadiya <shubham@spectra-vision.com> Cc: Milan Gondaliya <milan@spectra-vision.com>; Jignesh M. Prajapati <Jignesh.Prajapati@zyduslife.com>; ITSUPPORT VATVA <ITSUPPORT.VATVA@ZydusLife.com>; Kisan Patel <Kisan.Patel@ZydusLife.com>; Setul Patel <setul@spectra-vision.com>; Raaj Thanki <raaj@spectra-vision.com>; Ravi Daslaniya <Ravi.Daslaniya@ZydusLife.com>; support <support@spectra-vision.com>; Krudip D. Patel <Krudip.Patel@zyduslife.com> Subject: RE: [EXTERNAL] Re: Fwd: In-Out punch has not been updated for three days(ZHL-VATVA) Dear Spectra Team Still ZHL VATVA employee's in-out punch has not been updated .(From 1st may 2025)
comments:
1. The client reported that attendance data is not displaying for the period from 1st May to 6th May.
2. I checked the database page in the software and found that the device is active, with no pending transactions.
3. I have requested the client to share specific examples so that I can verify the issue from our end as well.
solution:
**Issue:**
The client reported that attendance data for several employees from May 1 to May 6 was missing, with only a single punch recorded per day.
**Investigation:**
1. After receiving the list of affected employees, I reviewed the data for 2–3 individuals and confirmed that only one punch was recorded per day.
2. I accessed the database menu on the devices and verified that all devices were active, with no pending transactions.
3. I retrieved the data log files from the Zydus server for May 1 to May 6 and extracted them using the Log Extractor tool.
4. Upon filtering the data by employee card ID, I found that while the attendance data was present, the MAC addresses were incorrect, causing the data to be unreadable by the software.
**Resolution:**
5. I manually corrected the MAC addresses in each data log file and moved the updated files to a separate folder.
6. I created a "Recover" folder within the services directory and transferred all corrected files into it.
7. I restarted the Spectra Worker service to initiate the recovery process.
8. After allowing sufficient time for the recovery command to execute, I confirmed that all files were successfully recovered.
9. Upon checking the software, the attendance data was now displaying correctly for all affected employees.

name: iApp
description_plain: When I open the Contract Workforce Master page, a server error is displayed.
comments:
1. The client reported that when they open the Contract Worker Master page, a server error appears on the page.
2. I checked from my end, and no error was displayed on my login. Therefore, I requested the client to kindly share their login credentials so I could investigate from my side as well.
3. After the client shared their login credentials, I logged in and found the error on the Contract Master page. I then accessed the Zydus server and executed the following query in the database:
   ```sql
   SELECT * FROM usersettings (NOLOCK)
   WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM UserMaster WHERE username = '109896')
   AND category = 'Filtering';
   ```
4. I identified 15 incorrect filters applied by the client. To resolve this, I removed all the filters using the following query:
   ```sql
   DELETE FROM usersettings
   WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM UserMaster WHERE username = '109896')
   AND category = 'Filtering';
   ```
5. After executing the above query, I reopened the software, and the error no longer appeared. The issue has been resolved.

   ```sql
   SELECT * FROM machineheader WHERE commandstatus = 'P';
   ```

5. I removed the affected entries from the `machineheader` table and cleared the machine data commands from the devices.
6. I advised the client to wait for some time before checking again. After a brief period, the commands began processing correctly.

comments:
1. The client reported that the turnstile device IP addresses need to be updated, as they were changed by the local IT team.
2. Based on the client's list, I checked each device and found that 10 turnstile devices had their IP addresses changed at the Sikkim 2 location.
3. I accessed the device menu and attempted to update the IP addresses one by one, but the commands were not executing.
4. I connected to the Zydus server and pinged each device individually; all devices responded correctly. I then opened the bootloader application, where all devices appeared, but with different MAC addresses.
5. I cross-referenced the MAC addresses with the device IPs in the software and updated each device's MAC address accordingly.
6. After waiting for the device data to synchronize, all devices are now showing as active in the software.

ticket_title: In-Out punch has not been updated for three days(ZHL-VATVA)
description_plain: Thank you for your support. Request you to share your feedback and rate our services offered by clicking the feedback link below.
comments:
1. **Issue Reported:** The client reported that from 1st May to 6th May, only one punch per day was being recorded for many employees, despite multiple punches being made on the device.
2. **Initial Check:** I accessed the Employee Master and navigated to the Miscellaneous menu, where I confirmed that only one punch per day was being registered.
3. **Device Status:** I checked the device, and it was showing as active with no visible transaction records during the affected period.
4. **Data Log Verification:** I connected to the Zydus server, copied the data log files for the six-day period, extracted them using the Log Extractor utility, and filtered the data using employee card IDs. I confirmed that multiple punches were present in the log files.
5. **Resolution Steps:** Since this issue was affecting many employees, I copied all the extracted data log files, created a recovery folder in the services directory, and restarted the Spectra Worker service. I then allowed time for the system to reprocess and read all the log files.
solution: Data log file recover successfully and data are showing correctly now.

ticket_title: New RFID punch card access assign issue
description_plain: Dear Support Team, New contract workers are unable to punch at the turnstile because the access assign time data is not being processed further. Please resolve this issue at the earliest. Thanks &
comments:
1. Issue Reported: The client reported that when attempting to assign access to an employee, a blank page appeared with no commands being displayed.

description_plain: Some issue with registering fingerprint
comments: As we checked they were using HID reader on all controller except from one controller where they are using Biostamp 2R for reader so while access with HID card its shows 18146 card ID but while punching through finger it shows 36292 card ID. We convert it in binary 18146 = 0100011011100010, 36292 = 1000110111000100 and found starting one bit extended so we set the no. of start bit as 1 instead  of 0 and also no of stop bit as 1. Reassign the card format on reader and made sample punch through finger hence its worked and issue has been resolved.

description_plain:
This is to inform you that our gate 1 turnstile showing wrong date and time on display  kindly update the correct time .
Turnstile IP No. 172:28:56:86
Kindly update
comments:
1. Issue Reported: The client reported that the date and time on Flap Barrier Device 1 were incorrect, which led to inaccurate data being generated in the system.
2. Initial Troubleshooting:
   I accessed the database menu in the software and confirmed that the date and time were incorrect—specifically, the date showed as the 23rd and the time as 23:59. I attempted to sync the date and time for the device. Although the sync command was successfully sent, the date and time remained incorrect. I repeated the process 2–3 times, but the issue persisted.
3. Firmware Update:
   I accessed the Zydus server, opened the bootloader application, and updated the firmware of the BioScribe 3S device.
4. Port Configuration:
   After the firmware update, I noticed that the server port configuration was incorrect. I updated the server port settings in the device and restarted it.
5. Final Verification:
   I reopened the database page in the software, re-synced the date and time, and verified that the date and time are now displaying correctly.

comments:
The license count will be determined based on the door system configuration. For example, if you are using the QuadXs 2C device, the license count depends on the number of doors that are enabled.

    If two doors are selected in the configuration, the license will count for two doors.

    If a door is not selected (i.e., "enable door" is not checked), that door will not be included in the license count.
